questions.q: In which series did Wolverine debut in 1974?
questions.why: Wolverine had a cameo in The Incredible Hulk #180 and full debut in #181.
John Romita Sr. designed Wolverine, who was created by Len Wein.

questions.q: What is Wolverine's birth name, as revealed in the Origin miniseries?
questions.why: The Origin miniseries gave his birth name as James Howlett.
Wolverine was born near Cold Lake, Alberta, Canada.

questions.q: Which actor first played Wolverine in 2000's X-Men film?
questions.why: Hugh Jackman first played Wolverine in 2000.

questions.q: Which metal is bonded to Wolverine's skeleton?
questions.why: Adamantium was grafted to his skeleton in Weapon X.

questions.q: In 1993's Fatal Attractions, what are Wolverine's claws revealed to be made of?
questions.why: Fatal Attractions revealed his claws are natural bone, after Magneto stripped his adamantium.

questions.q: Who became Wolverine's archenemy in the 1986 Mutant Massacre arc?
questions.why: Sabretooth became Wolverine's archenemy in the Mutant Massacre arc.

questions.q: Who is Wolverine's fiancee in Japan, later poisoned by the Hand?
questions.why: Mariko Yashida was engaged to Wolverine and was poisoned by the Hand.

questions.q: Who created the 1991 Weapon X story arc?
questions.why: Barry Windsor-Smith's Weapon X story depicts adamantium being grafted to him.

questions.q: Who teamed with Chris Claremont on the 1982 four-issue Wolverine miniseries?
questions.why: Frank Miller worked with Claremont on the 1982 miniseries.
